metadata.description: Deterministic spec and plan governance for coding agents.

plugins.name: planlint-spec-governance
plugins.description: Validate OpenSpec or SpecKit change packages (proposal.md, spec.md, tasks.md) against a repository's real Makefile targets, coverage floor, waivers and witnesses using the deterministic planlint CLI. Use when asked to validate, lint, check or repair specs or implementation plans, before writing code from a plan, or when a spec-gate CI job fails. Read-only by default; never writes waivers or witnesses.
